summary: The bad flow passes untrusted data into response.setHeader("Location", ...) without sanitizing CR/LF, enabling HTTP response splitting (CWE-113). The fix URL-encodes the data before concatenating it into the Location header value in the badSink method. URLEncoder.encode percent-encodes carriage return and line feed (and other unsafe characters), neutralizing header/response splitting while preserving the legitimate behavior of passing the value as the lang query parameter. The URLEncoder import already present in 51b is now used.
